Resolves #20974

Grid and table `bulkUpdateRecords` delegate whole-record payloads to `Store.updateRecords`, which maps declared writable fields into one `updateRows` batch without hydrating raw rows. Both store methods share the field-eligibility rule. The table body follows `rowsChange` and repaints changed rendered rows in one update.

Evidence: L3 (colors and finance displayed-cell checks in local Chrome) -> L3 required (AC-4 live app updates). No residuals.

## AC Evidence

| Criterion | Evidence |
| --- | --- |
| AC-1 | CI-covered: `unit/grid/ContainerBulkUpdateRecords.spec.mjs` covers grid batches, raw rows, identity, nested values, frozen inputs, sorter and filter reapplication. |
| AC-2 | CI-covered: the same parameterized suite covers the table; `unit/table/BodyRowsChange.spec.mjs` covers batch repainting and ordinary edits. |
| AC-3 | CI-covered: both adapter arms omit keys, calculated and undeclared fields. `unit/data/StoreUpdateRecords.spec.mjs` additionally covers returned missing keys and inherited updates to collapsed tree rows. |
| AC-4 | CI-covered: `e2e/colors/BulkUpdateRecords.spec.mjs` reads displayed cells after a live tick in both colors and finance. |

## Deltas from ticket

`Store.updateRecords(records)` is the shared whole-record entry point beside `updateRows`; container signatures are unchanged. This replaces the separate `Neo.util.Store` class and shares the writable-field predicate with the row writer, addressing RA-1.

size-guard-growth: src/data/Store.mjs — Own the whole-record adapter beside the batch writer and share its writable-field check while removing the separate utility class.

## Test Evidence

All coverage runs in CI.

Local verification: 45 focused Store, TreeStore, Grid and Table tests pass, and both live-app checks pass in Chrome. The full local unit run produced 7,507 passes, three skips and three failures. After staging the deleted utility, the three affected spec files were rerun: 32 passed, with only `claimResponderPagination.spec.mjs:398` still failing.

That remaining workflow test also fails on untouched PR head `9f400a8ec7`. It derives a stale timestamp from `Date.now()` but fixes the incoming claim at November 16. A diagnostic run on that untouched head with `Date.now()` pinned to November 16 passes. This is a date-sensitive baseline failure, not a passing full-suite receipt.

## Post-Merge Validation

None required beyond normal CI and maintainer review.

Authored by @amritkang165 (OpenAI GPT-6.1 Sol, reasoning: default, OpenAI Codex).

     /**
+     * @summary Whether a row batch may write a declared model field under the store's resolved key.
+     * @param {String} name Fully qualified field name.

+     * @param {String} keyProperty The store's resolved key field.
+     * @returns {Boolean}
+     * @private
+     */
+    #isWritableRowField(name, field, keyProperty) {
+        return !!field && !field.calculate && name !== keyProperty
+    }
+
+    /**
+     * @summary Applies whole-record updates to existing rows as one batch. The key locates the row. Only declared
+     * writable fields are copied, including leaves of nested input objects. The caller's objects stay untouched.
+     * @param {Object[]} records Whole-record input containing the store's key field.
+     * @returns {{errors: Error[], missing: Array}} The result of {@link #updateRows}.

+    updateRecords(records) {
+        const me          = this,
+              keyProperty = me.getKeyProperty(),
+              {model}     = me;

+        function collect(data, values, prefix='') {
+            for (const [name, value] of Object.entries(data)) {
+                const path  = prefix + name,
+                      field = model.getField(path);
+
+                if (me.#isWritableRowField(path, field, keyProperty)) {
+                    values[path] = value
+                } else if (!field && Neo.isObject(value)) {
+                    collect(value, values, path + '.')
+                }
+            }
+        }
+

+            const values = {};
+
+            collect(record, values);
+            return {key: record[keyProperty], values}
+        }))
